## Policy Ingestion (motor)
Run once (and again after changing the document).
Reads the policy wording PDF, splits it clause by clause (structural header injection, as in Chedi's ingestion), tags each chunk with clause_id / title / product_scope and stores it in the Qdrant collection **motor_policy_clauses** with NVIDIA embeddings.

Before a re-run, delete the collection in Qdrant (http://localhost:6333/dashboard) to avoid duplicates.
